messages:
mike: Heads up — rolling out keystore authz tighten in us-west-2 tomorrow 02:00 UTC. This will restrict keystore AssumeRole to privatelink proxies only. Could lead to GPU nodes failing ephemeral key fetch on join.

anita: what's the risk to warm pools? will nodes drop out? :thinking:

mike: could see 1-3m join delays, potentially causing autoscaler to spin extra nodes. Worst-case: ~5% capacity loss for ~10m in the window.

sara: can we do a staged canary? staging -> canary-prod (small AZ) -> full? add a fallback that allows node to use cached key if keystore returns 403.

ops-oncall: @mike please add me to the runbook. I'll monitor GPU-join-latency, warm-pool-size, and keystore-403-rate.

mike: Runbook draft pasted below:
```
- t+0: flip keystore authz in canary subnet us-west-2a
- t+5m: verify keystore-403-rate < 0.1%
- t+10m: increase warm-pool target by +20% if join-latency > 30s
- rollback: revert authz, purge node key cache, re-run joins
```

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary at 2026-03-22T02:00:00Z -> us-west-2a (id: cb-331)

keystore-bot: Note: key access denied events will be logged to /audit/keystore/us-west-2. Expect ~120k events/hour in worst-case for the region.

anita: that audit volume — what's estimated CloudTrail/Log Ingest cost? we need a budget hold.

sara: quick calc: 120k events/hr * 6KB avg = ~720MB/hr -> ~17GB/day -> ~500GB/mo. At $0.03/GB ingest ~ $15/mo for this spike. (ballpark)

mike: ok we'll add a temporary retention rule (7d) and route to archive after 24h.

ops-oncall: I'll open an alert: `keystore.403_rate > 0.5% for 5m` and `warmpool.size < desired - 15%`

anita: also confirm IAM policy change PR link?

mike: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pull/4132 — policy narrows `sts:AssumeRole` to `role/keystore-proxy-usw2` and adds condition `aws:sourceVpc`.

sara: test suggestion — simulate 403s locally with:
```
curl -X POST https://keystore.svc.usw2.internal/v1/get -H 'x-role: broken'
```
We did a dry-run in staging, saw join latency bump ~22s.

ops-oncall: I'm oncall for the window. I'll be connected to war room and will escalate if join failures > 1% for 10m.

mike: thanks all. rolling plan set. tagging @security for visibility.

security: (automated) Noted. Please include `audit: keystore` in SOC report.

anita: :thumbsup:
